📖 How to use

  1. Open the tool — your live screen and viewport stats appear immediately.
  2. Resize the window or rotate your device to watch values update.
  3. Use the 96px reference bar to sanity-check CSS sizing.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Screen size vs viewport size?

screen.width/height are the full display in CSS pixels; window.innerWidth/innerHeight are the current browser viewport, which shrinks with devtools or sidebars.

What is devicePixelRatio?

devicePixelRatio (e.g. 2 on Retina) — CSS pixels are multiplied by it to get physical device pixels.

Does it update live?

Yes — the values refresh on window resize and on orientation change, so rotate your phone to watch them update.

Is this private?

Yes, everything is read from live browser APIs on your device only.
